description:
Brand Introduction:

AlienRider specializes in innovative, high-tech solutions for motorcycle enthusiasts. With a focus on blending advanced technology with practicality, the brand offers premium products designed to enhance safety, convenience, and riding experience. AlienRider aims to redefine the motorcycle accessories market with intelligent and feature-packed devices.

Product Description:

• M2PRO: A complete system for motorcycle riders, featuring a display for phone connectivity through CarPlay and Android Auto. It also includes cameras that function as dashcams and a radar for blind-spot detection, ensuring an advanced and safe riding experience.

• M901 Spotlights: High-tech motorcycle spotlights equipped with dual-level auxiliary lights that activate cornering lights when leaning into curves. With an ARM Architecture chip, optical lenses, and a smart light sensor, these IP67 waterproof spotlights deliver smart performance under all conditions.

• M2S: A sleek, compact device designed for motorcycle connectivity. The M2S supports CarPlay and Android Auto integration, offering riders easy access to navigation, calls, and media directly from their bikes. Built for durability, it ensures seamless connectivity and enhances the overall riding experience.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

• Smart Features: Products like the M2PRO and M901 Spotlights include intelligent systems such as blind-spot detection and adaptive lighting.

• Durability: IP67-rated waterproof and dustproof designs ensure reliable performance.

• Ease of Integration: Universally compatible designs make AlienRider products easy to install on a variety of motorcycle models.

• Rider-Centric Innovation: Developed for improved safety, comfort, and convenience.

Payment Terms:

AlienRider accepts secure payments via major payment methods, including credit cards, online banking, and platforms like PayPal, ensuring convenience and buyer protection. Specific payment terms can vary depending on the platform or retailer offering AlienRider products.

Other Information:

AlienRider is dedicated to delivering premium customer service and continuously innovates to stay ahead of the curve in motorcycle technology. With a mission to enhance rider safety and enjoyment, the brand emphasizes quality and long-term reliability. More details and additional products are available on their official website.
